💡 guardian-cli | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Automating and enhancing penetration testing workflows with AI intelligence and a comprehensive suite of security tools.
✨ Key Features: • Multi-Provider AI Intelligence (7+ providers including local Ollama, OpenAI, Gemini, Claude) • Plugin Provider Contract for easy third-party integration • Multi-Agent Architecture with specialized roles and debate triage • Vision-LLM Visual Triage for image-grounded analysis
📖 Summary: Guardian is an AI-powered penetration testing automation framework that integrates multiple AI providers and a wide array of security tools. It aims to deliver intelligent, adaptive security assessments with features like multi-agent debate triage and RAG-based knowledge bases to reduce false positives and improve efficiency.
